source.name: Arab News - Dakar Rally Saudi Arabia 2027 route unveiled
source.note: Route launched by Saudi Motorsport Co. and ASO in cooperation with SAMF under the supervision of the Ministry of Sport; start and finish at King Abdullah Economic City, 1-15 Jan 2027.

note: Co-organiser and host-side operator; institutional partner on dakar.com (saudimotorsport.com). SMC founded 2021, chaired by Prince Khalid bin Sultan Al-Abdullah Al-Faisal.
